AI Notes.value: Veteran pixel artist, illustrator and author (b. 1956), living on Orcas Island, Washington. Industry legend in color cycling: illustrated all original backgrounds for LucasArts Loom and some of The Secret of Monkey Island, later Ron Gilbert's Thimbleweed Park; his color-cycling technique (animation via palette manipulation on a still image) is iconic and now lives in his Living Worlds app (iOS/Android). Also a published novelist (The Book of Joby, Tor 2007) and runs an illustrated serial, TWICE. Very senior, ~40 yr career; fully autonomous master of his craft (Autonomy 5). Work Status Unknown: LinkedIn lists him as illustrator at Amaze Entertainment (Kirkland WA gaming company, closed 2009), so that role is historical not current; his own site and contact page give no employer signal; conflicting reports of background/concept art for a Seattle game company remain unresolved below the confidence bar. No public email; site contact page is a form with links to Twitter/Facebook only. Socials: Twitter/Facebook at @Mawkyman (linked from his site).
